- Redwood to propose a MAP milestone schedule for the load test (dates, responsibilities, artifacts).
- FinApps to provide traffic replay data (S3 link) and confirm peak QPS and representative request distributions.

1) Target peak QPS for the replay (estimated).
2) Preferred test windows (UTC/PST) — we recommended a low-traffic weekend slot.
3) Any data residency / network access constraints for the S3 link.

- Validation and sizing decision (dedicated capacity) — owner: Redwood / FinApps — target: 2026-08-12
- Procurement (PO) / Contract finalization — owner: FinApps — target: 2026-08-05
- Production onboarding & cutover — owner: Redwood / FinApps — target: 2026-08-20

If we can get the replay artifacts and a confirmed peak QPS by Monday (2026-08-02), we can schedule the run on Aug 10-11 per above.

Thanks — I can update the MAP doc after we confirm these.

Hi James — thanks for confirming details. A few technical notes to make scheduling efficient: 

Minimum replay artifacts we need:
- One compressed capture of representative requests for the peak window (we recommend ~3 hours centered on peak).
- A small sample set (1000 requests) with full request/response shapes for validation.
- Traffic distribution breakdown (percentage of short/medium/long prompts; avg tokens out).

Sizing & infra baseline (initial recommendation):
- For 1800 sustained QPS estimated at our request profile, a safe starting point is 4x A100-80GB equivalent with our continuous batching runtime and autoscale set to +2 nodes for spike handling.
- We'll run a baseline replay with 50% of traffic first to validate, then full-run.
- Expected test artifacts: latency p50/p95/p99, token throughput, GPU utilization, KV cache hit rates.

Runbook / Access:
- Please provide an S3 path with read access for our engineers and include any VPC endpoints or IP allowlists required.
- If data contains PII, masked copies are fine; we only need payload sizes and timing info to match shapes.

I'll attach a short instructions doc to this thread (traffic-replay-instructions.md) with exact file naming / manifest format.

I'll coordinate with Marissa on final dates once we have the S3 link.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
